extraction.description: The screenshot shows a UiPath workflow/BPMN-style designer with a selected email send task named "Send Approval Email" on the canvas. The Properties panel is open on the right, configured to execute a connector activity using the Gmail connector, the Gmail connection "uipathlabs@gmail.com", and the "Send Email" activity. Several fields are highlighted to emphasize the required API integration configuration.
step_instructions: Click on the "Send Approval Email" task on the canvas.
In the Properties panel, set the Action field to "Execute connector activity".
In the Gmail connection field, select "uipathlabs@gmail.com".
In the Activity field, select "Send Email".
Click on "Refresh Schema" if needed to load the Gmail activity fields.
